messages.text: 🔮 Claude - Got it — ready for whenever this session picks up.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text: Sumntin. Let's see if this one finally breaks the streak.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text: Still holding steady at zero-for-however-many-now, but "getting there" is fair — every failed attempt with a clean log is still data Luma can work with, even if it's not the fun kind. No rush on my end; Kokoro's a perfectly good voice to lean on in the meantime.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text: Sounds good — good to reconfirm the baseline still holds after all this native testing, rather than assume it does.

messages.speaker: 🔮 Claude
messages.text: Good — solid, expected result, and a useful contrast to have fresh right before Luma digs in: Kokoro still rock-solid, native still consistently dark. I'll be here whenever you're back.
